    //==
    // # Placed SDF evaluation
    //
    // Bodies for `PlacedSdf2D/3D` (`implicit-sdf.types.plato`): a source field
    // moved by a rigid pose and a uniform scale. Evaluation pulls the query point
    // back into the source's own frame and pushes the resulting distance forward
    // by the scale, which is a similarity and so preserves fidelity outright: the
    // result is exact, a lower bound, or not a bound exactly as its source is.

    // The query position in the source field's own frame: the pose undone, then
    // the uniform scale undone. Precondition: Scale is positive.
    SourcePoint(self: PlacedSdf2D, point: Point2D): Point2D {
        var local = point.Transform(self.Pose.Inverse);
        return Point2D(local.X / self.Scale, local.Y / self.Scale);
    }

    // The query position in the source field's own frame. Precondition: Scale is
    // positive.
    SourcePoint(self: PlacedSdf3D, point: Point3D): Point3D {
        var local = point.Transform(self.Pose.Inverse);
        return Point3D(local.X / self.Scale, local.Y / self.Scale, local.Z / self.Scale);
    }

    // The placed planar distance: the source distance at the pulled-back position,
    // scaled back into world units. Exact when the source is.
    Eval(self: PlacedSdf2D, point: Point2D): Number
        => self.Source.Eval(self.SourcePoint(point)) * self.Scale;

    // The placed spatial distance, scaled back into world units. Exact when the
    // source is.
    Eval(self: PlacedSdf3D, point: Point3D): Number
        => self.Source.Eval(self.SourcePoint(point)) * self.Scale;

    // Place a planar function SDF by a rigid pose and a uniform scale.
    // Precondition: scale is positive.
    Placed(self: FunctionSdf2D, pose: Pose2D, scale: Number): PlacedSdf2D
        => (self, pose, scale);

    // Place a spatial function SDF by a rigid pose and a uniform scale.
    // Precondition: scale is positive.
    Placed(self: FunctionSdf3D, pose: Pose3D, scale: Number): PlacedSdf3D
        => (self, pose, scale);

    // Place a planar function SDF by a rigid pose, at its original size.
    Placed(self: FunctionSdf2D, pose: Pose2D): PlacedSdf2D
        => self.Placed(pose, 1.0);

    // Place a spatial function SDF by a rigid pose, at its original size.
    Placed(self: FunctionSdf3D, pose: Pose3D): PlacedSdf3D
        => self.Placed(pose, 1.0);

    // Any planar SDF placed by a rigid pose and a uniform scale. The field is
    // lifted into stored-function form first. Precondition: scale is positive.
    Placed(self: ISignedDistanceField2D, pose: Pose2D, scale: Number): PlacedSdf2D
        => self.FunctionSdf2D.Placed(pose, scale);

    // Any spatial SDF placed by a rigid pose and a uniform scale.
    // Precondition: scale is positive.
    Placed(self: ISignedDistanceField3D, pose: Pose3D, scale: Number): PlacedSdf3D
        => self.FunctionSdf3D.Placed(pose, scale);
